reviews.title: Great rope
reviews.body: I bought this to add some cardio to my home workouts and I’m really pleased with it. The handles are comfortable and don’t slip even when my hands get sweaty, and the cable spins smoothly without tangling.The adjustable length was a big plus — it took me about 30 seconds to size it properly. reviews.title: Great for kids and adults
reviews.body: I got these for Easter for each of my kids (8, 10, 12) and they have been a hit. Better quality than the cheap dollar store ropes we’ve had before, and I love the added motivation from the digital counting feature—they love a good competition! You do have to assemble them before use, so be prepared for that, but my husband didn’t seem to have any trouble setting them up. I was worried these might be too big, especially for my youngest, but they’re easily adjustable and have worked great for the kids and adults in the house.
